title: FindingEnvelope
description: Unified agent-facing response shape returned by every diagnostic-bearing json2pptx surface (validate, validate-template, template-check, generate -dry-run, repair, inspect, preflight, examine-template, and their MCP / HTTP serve-mode equivalents). See docs/AGENT_DIAGNOSTICS.md section 2.

input_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the request payload, for correlation.

template.description: Template the run targeted, when applicable.

ok.description: True when no finding has error severity.

summary.description: Short human-readable roll-up, e.g. '2 errors, 1 warning'.

findings.description: The list of issues; may be empty.

where.description: Location of a finding within a deck or template. All fields optional.

params.description: Action-specific arguments (which row to split at, the replacement value, the target placeholder, etc.).

remediation.description: Structured repair: a primary action plus ranked alternatives.

tool_call_suggestion.description: A machine-readable next tool call an agent can replay to recover from or investigate the finding.

args_template.description: Argument template for the call; the agent fills in the offending value.

category.description: The namespace prefix of code. Present on every surface except validate_deck_spec, which leaves it out: the code starts with it.

blocking.description: DeckSpec surfaces: true exactly when severity is error.

path.description: DeckSpec surfaces: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901, 0-based) into the spec that was sent. It always resolves there.

missing_path.description: DeckSpec surfaces: the field the finding is about when the spec does not have it; path is then its nearest existing parent.

slide_number.description: 1-based position of the slide in the rendered deck (a split_slide page and a structure deck's agenda and dividers count). Absent on a deck-level finding and on an entry that spans slides. A tool's slide_index is this number minus one.

occurrences.description: DeckSpec surfaces: how many findings with this code and cause the entry stands for.

paths.description: DeckSpec surfaces: the path of each finding the entry stands for. Evidence facts that differ per item (measured) are lists in this order.

evidence.description: Machine-readable facts (measured vs. allowed extents, overflow ratios, the finding's JSON Pointer into the deck that was sent as path, expected type, asset kind/value, suggestion lists). Scalars and lists of facts are carried; arbitrary nested objects are dropped.

patch_verified.description: DeckSpec surfaces: next_tool_call's patch was applied to the spec and validated by the server; this finding is gone and no new blocking finding appeared. Only ever true, and only on a patch that is complete as written.

example_value.description: Representative valid value for the offending argument/field. Any JSON type.

debug.description: Locators that name objects the author did not write. DeckSpec surfaces: into the compiled deck (raw_path, cell_path). Raw-deck surfaces: locator, the engine's own path when it differs from the authored evidence.path (an expanded slide index, a cell of a pattern or compose grid, slide chrome, a written shape).

describe_command.description: Executable command that explains the code, e.g. 'json2pptx describe-finding placeholder_overflow'.
